tips_en: Start with DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash (Paper 2): its aggressive KV-cache compression (FP4, CSA2, CED architecture) is the infrastructure layer that makes long-horizon agents economically viable, and it directly complements Paper 3's harness-level optimizations in SoL-Pi—together they represent a coordinated attack on agent deployment cost from two different stack layers. Paper 1 (LimiX-2) is more standalone but intellectually provocative, showing that emergent causal reasoning can arise in tabular foundation models via joint mechanism learning rather than autoregressive next-token prediction.
tips_zh: 建议先读 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash（论文2）：其激进的 KV 缓存压缩（FP4、CSA2、CED 架构）是让长程智能体在经济上可行的基础设施层，并与论文 3 中 SoL-Pi 的 harness 层优化形成直接互补——二者从架构栈的不同层面协同解决智能体部署成本问题。论文 1（LimiX-2）相对独立但思路令人耳目一新：通过联合机制学习而非自回归下一 token 预测，在表格基础模型中实现了涌现的因果推理能力。
